column4: Execute a benign payload via PowerShell to test script-block logging and AMSI detection.
column6:
1. Open PowerShell as a standard user.
2. Run Invoke-Expression with a benign Base64-encoded payload.
3. Observe ScriptBlock logging in Windows PowerShell event log.
4. Attempt AMSI bypass technique (safe PoC only).
5. Verify detection: EID 4104 script block logged; AMSI alert triggered.
column7: EID 4104: script block logging captures encoded/decoded payload. AMSI: detection of obfuscated or known-bad string pattern. Alert: PowerShell encoded command execution by non-admin user.
column8: Windows PowerShell EID 4104 (script block log); Sysmon EID 1 (powershell.exe -enc); AMSI provider log
